It follows a similar format to, and is broadcast at the same time as "Peston on Sunday".
Robert Peston | Robert James Kenneth Peston (born 25 April 1960) is a British journalist and presenter. A long established personality in the West Midlands region, he has presented programmes on BBC Coventry & Warwickshire and BBC WM for several years, where he is probably best known for a weekly Irish music show aired on Sunday afternoons.
Sophy Ridge | Sophy Arabella Ridge (born 17 October 1984) is an English broadcast journalist.  Ridge was born and raised in Richmond upon Thames, London.  Her early education was at the Tiffin Girls' School.  After graduation from St Edmund Hall, Oxford with a degree in English Literature, she worked as a journalist at the tabloid newspaper "News of the World".  Ridge then worked as a political correspondent for Sky News where as of 2017 she presents "Sophy Ridge on Sunday".

After graduation from St Edmund Hall, Oxford with a degree in English Literature, she worked as a journalist at the tabloid newspaper "News of the World".  Ridge then worked as a political correspondent for Sky News where as of 2017 she presents "Sophy Ridge on Sunday".
The Sunday Mail (Brisbane) | The Sunday Mail is Brisbane's only Sunday newspaper.  The Sunday Mail is published in tabloid format, comprising several sections that can be extracted and read separately.  It is available for purchase throughout Queensland, most regions of Northern New South Wales and parts of the Northern Territory.
Sunday's Well | Sunday's Well (Irish: Tobar Rí an Domhnaigh) is a suburb of the city of Cork in Ireland.  It is situated in the north-west of the city, on a ridge on the northern bank of the River Lee.
Chimera (Irish band) | Chimera were a Northern Irish alternative rock band that saw brief, but notable fame in the mid-nineties.  They have been frequently compared to the Sundays, Cocteau Twins and the Cranberries.
